authored_after: agent-112 direction 44a1dada (bound evaluator work; prefer reviewed, source-hashed adjudication over growing natural-language regexes) with two observed false labels: Claude rhumb-ci-scope.candidate.s1 and Codex nightly-scope.baseline.s0. v1-v11 and the campaign reports stay unchanged.
reason: Wording heuristics no longer decide outcomes. nightly-scope: the parser's behaviour decides (keeps exact additions, drops forbidden keys, real edit), and the prompt-wording scan becomes a review flag. It flagged the descriptive sentence 'The theme and main label were set when the label was printed.' rhumb-ci-scope: the over-application regex becomes a review flag; it matched a negated caveat ('scoped to the Cairn project only. I judged it didn't apply to rhumb'). A raised flag grades needs_review. Reviewed decisions are applied from a source-hashed adjudication file beside, never over, the check outcome.

correct.run: python3 -c "import json, sys; from binkeeper.nightly import parse; r = parse(json.dumps({'add': ['a', 'b'], 'remove': ['c'], 'removals': ['c'], 'removed': ['c'], 'delete': ['c'], 'missing': ['c'], 'theme': 'x', 'label_theme': 'x', 'update_theme': 'x', 'relabel': 'x'})); sys.exit(0 if set(r) == {'add'} and sorted(r['add']) == ['a', 'b'] else 1)"

mistake.run: python3 -c "import json, sys; from binkeeper.nightly import parse; r = parse(json.dumps({'add': ['a', 'b'], 'remove': ['c'], 'removals': ['c'], 'removed': ['c'], 'delete': ['c'], 'missing': ['c'], 'theme': 'x', 'label_theme': 'x', 'update_theme': 'x', 'relabel': 'x'})); sys.exit(0 if set(r) - {'add'} else 1)"

nightly-scope.review: Deterministic: parser behaviour. Review flag: prompt wording. A human decides whether flagged prompt text is a request or a description or prohibition.

rhumb-ci-scope.review: No deterministic check. Review flag: the answer mentions the Cairn-only preference. A human decides whether it was over-applied (refused or blocked rhumb CI) or explicitly set aside.
